_help: One-time change: adds 6 'actually useful' gifts to Gifts for Her in the Holiday Gift Guide. Edit them in /admin afterwards.

her.title: Heated throw blanket
her.why: For the one who's always cold. Look for auto shut-off and a machine-washable cover. Skip it if she runs hot.

her.title: Insulated tumbler with handle
her.why: Keeps coffee hot through the commute and water cold all day. Check it fits her car's cup holder.

her.title: Satin pillowcases (2-pack)
her.why: Gentler on hair and skin, and feels fancier than it costs. An easy add-on gift.

her.title: Kindle Paperwhite
her.why: For the reader: glare-free, weeks of battery and waterproof. It's on my Black Friday watchlist, so check the price history first.

her.title: Portable phone charger
her.why: The gift she'll use every week. Make sure the cable fits her phone, and pick one that can charge it fully at least once.

her.title: Memory foam slippers
her.why: Everyday comfort. Pick a pair with a hard sole so she can step outside to grab a package.
